project: Patient MDM - synthetic multi-source identity resolution
within_source_duplicate_rate_target: approximately 2.5% of records before duplicates are added
anomaly_rate_definition: Probability of applying one general perturbation to a record; source-specific and temporal perturbations may increase observed rate.
temporal_variations: Approximately 4% of records may receive a later updated timestamp and a changed phone or address.
important: ground_truth.csv and reference_population_private.csv must not be provided to matching algorithms.
hard_nonmatch_design: Within each source, selected records belonging to different synthetic people share first name, last name, and date of birth; other attributes may differ. Pair list is evaluation-only.
